tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /me mkha' rgya mtsho bzhugs lags so/ /

༄༅/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /me mkha' rgya mtsho rnams la ni//rab byung la sogs 'das lo bsre/ /kla klo'i lo ru rab tu grags// lag pa klu dang zla ba yis/ /kla klo'i dbang po phri ba yi/ /lhag ma lo yi dag pa yin | | zla ba'i don du nyi mas bsgyur/ /dpyid zla 'bring sogs 'das zla bsre// gnas gnyis bzhag pa'i 'og ma la/ /sde pa yis ni bsgyur bar bya/ /nam mkha' me dang zla bas bgo /rnyed pa steng la bcug pa yis/ /zla ba rnam par dag pa ni/ /'gyur ro mi yi bdag po kye/ /zla ba rnam par dag pa de/ /gnas gsum bzhag pa'i dbus ma la/ /lag pa rtse mo can gyis bsgyur/ /rtsa ba drug gis rnyed pa gang*/ /des ni dbus ma dbri bya zhing*/ steng 'og mig dang sum cu bsre/ / dbus ma drug cus thob pa yi/ /lhag ma gza' yi chu tshod yin/ /rnyed pa gang yin steng la gzhug /thub pa mchog rnams kyis steng bgo /bgos pa'i lhag ma gzar 'gyur ro/ /zla ba rnam par dag pa la/ /nyi zla bsres la gnas gnyis bzhag | 'og ma dus dang nyi mas bgo /lhag ma dag ni cha shas yin/ /steng ma lag pas bsgyur ba la/ /thob pa'i cha la lnga bsres te/ /steng la bcug ste klu lag gis/ /bgos pa'i lhag ma ril po'i gnas/ /zla dag ( 122 ) gnas gsum bzhag dbus ma/ /drag pos bsgyur te 'og ma la/ /dgu dang me yis thob la gnyis/ /bsres te bar ma sbyang bar bya/ /dbus ma drug cus thob pa yi// lhag ma skar ma'i chu tshod nyis/ /bgos pas thob pa'i rnyed pa de/ /steng ma mig gis bsgyur la bzhug /nyi shu bdun gyis bgos pa yi/ /lhag ma skar ma'i nges pa yin/ /zad par gyur na thig le sbyin/ /gza' ni gza' la rab sbyin zhing*/ / chu tshod du ni rgyal po gnyis/ /ril por gnyis te 'og tu gcig /skar mar gnyis dang skar ma yi/ /chu tshod du ni drag po sbyin/ /nyi ma'i longs spyod gsal bar 'gyur/ /'di dag zla ba re re yi/ /brtag par sla ba'i don du yin/

/ rmongs pas sngar bzhin zhib tu sbyin/ /nyin re'i nges pa btsal ba'i phyir/ / gza' yi gnas su tshes grangs sbyin/ /chu tshod gnas nas tshes kyis dbrog/ ril po'i gnas su tshes de sbyin/ /de la chu gter zla ba yis/ /bgos pa'i lhag mas rkang pa bzung*/ /thob pa'i mnyam dang mi mnyam las/ /bsnan dang sbyong bar shes par bya/ /ma thob na yang mnyam dang mtshungs/ /'byung dang 'byung ba mda' rig byed/ /me dang lag pa ri bong can/ /phyi ma la ni de las bzlog /zla ba'i rkang par shes par bya/ /stong pas stong pa rnam dag cing*/ /bcu gsum zla ba'i rkang pa lnga/ /mig dang nyi mar phyogs yin la/ /bcu gcig me ni tshes zhes bya/ /bcu dang chu bo rkang pa ru/ /nyi shu gcig gis ma tshang ba/ /lnga dang bu gar nyi shu gnyis/ /dus dang klu ru nyi shu bzhi/ /bdun par nyi shu rtsa lnga yin/ / rkang pa zos pa'i sngon ma yis/ /cha shas gnas la bsgyur bar bya/ /de la dus dang nyi ma yis/ /bgos pas thob pa chu tshod yin/ /lhag ma drug cus bsgyur ba las | | thob pa chu srang dag tu 'gyur/ /lhag ma drug gis bsgyur ba las/ /thob pa dbugs su 'gyur ba yin/ /de ltar thob pa rnams la ni/ /sngar gyi zla ba'i rkang pa yi/ /snga ma cha shas zos pa dang*/ /bsdom la gza' rnams snon dbri bya/ / phyi ma'i cha la ma zos la/ /phri las snon dbri bya ba ni/ /sngar gyi mtshan ma dag las shes/ /tshes grangs gnas gnyis dag tu bzhag /rig byed kyis ni steng ma bsgyur | | 'og gi sum cha steng la gzhug /de la drug cus thob pa yis/ /skad ma'i gnas la bsnan par bya/ /bgos pa'i lhag ma dbyu gu'i gnas/ /'og gi lhag ma chu srang yin/ /de nyid gnas gnyis dag tu bzhag /gong gi skar ma'i gnas nas drug /chu tshod gnas nas bzhi bcu lnga/ /sbyangs te med na 'khor lo phyed | | bsres la gong gi de dag sbyang*/ /sbyangs kyang 'khor lo phyed lhag na/ / 'khor lo phyed ni sbyangs byas la/ /sbyangs pa'i lhag ma drug cus bsgyur/

/de la 'og gi chu tshod bsre/ /mda' dang yon tan zla ba yis/ /bgos pa'i thob pas rkang pa gzung*/ /ro dang rig byed zla ba ste/ /phyi ma la ni de las bzlog /nyi ma'i rkang par shes par bya/ /nyi mar dus dang ro dang klu/ /bcu dang 'phrog byed 'phrog byed dang*/ /drag po'i phyogs dang klu dang drug /me dang nam mkha' zhes bya ba | | lho ru bgrod tshe dbri ba dang*/ /byang bgrod la ni bsnan bya ba/ /zla ba drug la zla phyed ni//bcu gnyis dag tu byas pas so/ /rkang pa zos pa'i sngon ma yis// skar ma'i gnas la bsgyur bar bya/ /de la thob pa chu tshod yin/ /drug cus bsgyur la thob chu srang*/ /ro yis bsgyur la thob pa dbugs/ /de ltar thob pa rnams kyis ni/ /sngar gyi nyi ma'i rkang pa yis/ /snga ma'i cha la zos pa dang*/ bsdom la snon dbri bya ba dang*/ /phyi ma'i cha la ma zos la/ /phri la snon dbri bya ba ni || lho byang 'gro ba'i dbang gis so/ /nyi ma'i longs spyod gnas gnyis bzhag/zla ba'i skar ma tshes grangs sbyin/ /'og tu tshes la ro yis bsgyur/ /de la gza' yi longs spyod bsre/ /de la drug cus thob pa yis/ /skar ma'i gnas la sbyang bar bya//lhag mas chu tshod la sogs sbyang*/ /gza' la bdun gyis bgos pa yi// lhag ma gza' yi nges pa yin/ /skar ma nyi shu rtsa bdun gyis/ skar ma'i gnas la sbyangs pa yi/ /lhag ma skar ma'i zos pa yin/ /nyi ma dang ni sbyor ba yang*/ / lhag ma zos pa yin par 'dod/ /de ltar zla ba'i longs spyod dang*/ /nyi ma'i longs spyod bsres byas la/ /nyi shu bdun gyis de bgos pas/ /sbyor bar 'gyur ro mi bdag kye/ /tshes la mig gis bsgyur ba la/ /gcig phri de la bdun gyis bag | de yi lhag ma byed pa yin/ /de ltar gza' dang tshes grangs dang*/ skar ma sbyor ba byed pa ste/ /yan lag lnga 'o mi'i bdag po// // nyi khyim 'pho ba'i nges pa ni/ /dag pa'i lo la klu yis bsre/ /de ni gnas gnyis dag tu bzhag

/mkha' dang nam mkha' chu bos bsgyur/ /klu dang bsres pas sbyang byas la/ /thub pa zla ba mes bgos pas/ /thob pa gza' yi gnas su bzhag /lhag ma drug cus bsgyur ba las/ /thob pa chu tshod gnas su bzhag | lhag ma drug cus bsgyur ba las/ thob pa chu srang dag tu bzhag /drug gis bsgyur las thob pa dbugs/ /de la gza' yi gnas su gnyis/ /chu tshod gnas su sum cu bsre/ /drug cus chu tshod la thob pa/ /gza' la bcug ste de nyid la/ /thub pas bgos pa'i lhag ma gza'/ /de ni spyi yi nges pa'o/ /lug la sogs pa rang rang gi /gza' yi nges pa gzhug pa dang*/ /chu tshod la ni chu tshod de | | gang la gang ni bcug pa de/ /de dang de yi khyim 'pho'o/ /gza' yi gnas su zla ba dang*/ /chu tshod gnas su lnga bcu bdun/ /de ni lug gi khyim 'pho'o// gza' gnas bzhi dang chu tshod du/ /lnga bcu rtsa gsum glang gi'o/ /gza' la zla ba chu tshod du/ /bcu bdun sbyin te 'khrig pa'o/ /gza' la bzhi dang chu tshod du// lnga bcu gsum ste karka ṭa/ /gza' la gcig ste chu tshod du/ /nyi shu gnyis te seng ge'o | | gza' ru bzhi dang chu tshod du/ /nyi shu bzhi ni bu mo'o/ /gza' la drug dang chu tshod du/ /lnga bcu gcig ni srang gi'o/ /gza' la gcig dang chu tshod du// bzhi bcu bdun ni sdig pa'o/ /gza' la gsum dang chu tshod du/ /bcu drug bzhag ste gzhu yi'o/ /gza' la drug dang chu tshod du/ /sum cu bdun ni chu srin yin | | gza' la drug dang chu tshod dang*/ /rig byed sbyin pa bum pa'o/ /gza' gnas stong dang chu tshod du/ /lnga bcu rtsa gnyis nya yi'o// //zla ba drug la nyin mtshan du/ /'phel dang 'grib pas nyi ma rgyu/ /nyi ma so so'i dus la ni/ /dbugs bzhi chu srang gsum gyis ni/ /'phel dang 'grib par bgrod pa yin/ /lho ru bgrod pas mtshan mo 'phel/ kha ba can gyi byang phyogs su | | bgrod pas nyin mo 'phel ba yin/ /zla ba rnam par dag pa la/ /mig dang nyi ma rnam par bsre/

/de ni lag pas bsgyur ba de/ /zla ba phyed pa'i phung por 'gyur/ /de la zla ba'i don du gcig /nyi ma'i don du gnyis bsres la/ / mkha' dus chu bos bgos pa ldan/ /skar mas bsgyur ba mkha' dus chus/ / bgos pas thob pa skar ma yin/ /de la drug cus bsgyur ba las/ /thob pa chu tshod dag tu 'gyur/ /drug cus bsgyur la thob chu srang*/ /drug gis bsgyur bas thob pa dbugs/ /de ltar thob pa rnams kyis ni/ /skar ma nyi shu rtsa bdun la/ / phri ba'i lhag ma mun can te/ /sgra gcan gdong gi longs spyod yin/ /de dang skar ma'i gnas mnyam na/ /gdong gis 'dzin te mi mnyam na/ /'khor lo phyed bsres mjug ma yi/ /longs spyod byas te skar ma yi/ /gnas dang mnyam na mjug mas 'dzin/ /gcig ni rab tu zhugs kyang 'dzin/ /de la zla ba 'dzin pa ni || nya dang bcu drug mtshams yin la/ /nyi ma 'dzin pa gnam stong dang*/ /tshes gcig mtshams la 'dzin par 'gyur/ /sgra gcan gdong gi 'phrog byed kyis/ / nyi ma zla ba'i longs spyod ni/ /thams cad 'phrogs na kun 'dzin la/ /phyed dang bzhi cha sogs dag na/ /phyed dang bzhi cha sogs 'dzin no/ /nyi zla lhor bgrod tshe na ni//byang gi phyogs nas 'dzin 'gyur la/ /byang bgrod tshe na lho nas 'dzin// mnyam na mdun rgyab nas 'dzin cing*/ /sgra gcan shar gnas shar nas 'dzin// byang bgrod tshe ni lho nas 'dzin/ /nub nas shar na nub nas 'dzin/ /ji tsam 'dzin pa'i yun tshod ni/ /sgra gcan gdong gi longs spyod dang*/ /nyi zla'i longs spyod bsres byas la/ /drug cus bsgyur na dbyug tshod ni/ /gcig gi yun tshod 'dzin pa yin//de la lhag mar gyur pa dang*/ /chad pa mkhas pas shes par bya// ci tsam dag na 'dzin pa'i tshod/ /gza' yi chu tshod kyis shes 'gyur/ /sgra mi snyan nas bzung nas ni/ /gling re chu tshod lnga lnga yin/ /byang phyogs nub pas mtshams 'dzin la/ /'dzam gling shar bas shar tshod 'dzin/ /lus 'phags po nyid phyed kyis 'dzin/

/nub phyogs nam phyed kyi mtshams 'dzin/ /nyin re'i 'gro ba'i gza' rnams ni/ /'dzam bu gling dang mthun par dbang*/ /tshes ni nyi zla'i 'phel 'grib kyis/ /nges pa med par 'pho ba yin/ /gza' dang gza' yi gnas su brtag /gza' yi chu tshod tshes kyi yin/ /de yi grangs kyis dus tshod brtag | nag pa tha skar zla ba yis/ /nya la chu tshod sum cu byung*/ /srod la zla ba 'dzin par 'gyur/ /sum cu lnga byung phyed gong du/ /bzhi bcu lnga byung phyed yol na// lnga bcu na ni tho rangs 'dzin/ /rgyal gyi zla ba chu srin gyi/ khyim gyi nya la nyi shu bzhi | | byung na srod la 'dzin par 'gyur/ /chu stod zla ba karka ṭa/ /nya yi nyin par sum cu drug /byung na de yi srod la 'dzin/ /zla ba re zhing chu tshod ni/ / gnyis gnyis 'phel zhing 'grib pa yin/ /nyi ma lho byang bgrod phyir ro/ /des na dpyad cing mkhas pas brtag /nyin dang mtshan mo'i ring tshad ni/ /sum cu drug yin thung tshad ni/ /nyi shu bzhir ni shes par bya/ /des na zla re'i 'phel 'grib kyi | | chu tshod gnyis gnyis 'phel 'grib ni/ /mkhas pas brtag te shes par bya | | nyi ma 'dzin pa'i rim pa ni/ /gza' gnas chu tshod gnyis dang gsum/ / nyi ma ring thung med pa ru/ /byung na snga dro 'dzin par 'gyur/ /nag pa tha skar zla ba yi | | gnam stong chu tshod nyi shu bzhi/ /byung na rgas khar 'dzin pa yin/ /chu srin khyim gyi gnam stong la/ /nyi shu gnyis byung rgas khar 'dzin/ /karka ṭa yi gnam stong la/ /sum cu so bzhi byung gyur na/ /de'ang rgas khar 'dzin pa yin/ /lhag ma mkhas pas rim gyis dpyad/ /spyir ni zla ba drug drug ni/ /zla ba phal cher 'dzin par 'gyur/ /gang du 'dzin sogs rtsis kyis dpyad/ /lo gcig la ni nyi ma ni/ /lan gcig 'dzin nam lan gnyis 'dzin/ /gal te lo ni bcu gnyis kyi | | bar du mi 'dzin dag kyang srid/ /gang ltar yin yang nya la ni/ /zla ba bzung ba'i gnam stong la/

/nyi ma 'dzin par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /rtsis kyis zhib tu dpyad par bya/ /gza' lnga gzhan ni sgra gcan gyis/ /zin pa dag tu mi 'gyur ro | | de la zla ba myur ba'i phyir/ /lan gnyis nges par 'dzin par 'gyur/ /nyi ma bul phyir bcu gnyis su/ /mi 'dzin dag kyang srid pa yin/ /gza' rnams lnga po gzhan dag la/ /myur ba dang ni bul ba dang*/ /drang po dang ni 'khyog po yi/ / rkang pa bzhi ni gnas pas na/ /mi 'dzin pa yi mtshan nyid do/ /nyi ma zla ba mig dmar dang*/ /lhag pa phur bu pa wa sangs/ /spen pa zhes bya'i gza' bdun ni// nyin re rim gyis dbang byed cing*/ /ldabs nas dbang ba yod pa yin/ /rim gyis 'khor lo bzhin du 'jug /mjug ring sgra gcan snga ma bag /ltau 'phye'i gzugs kyis nam mkha' la/ /bsod nams ldan pas g.yas bskor 'gro/ / gza' gzhan dag ni g.yon bskor 'gro/ /tha skar bra nye smin drug snar/ /mgo lag nabs so rgyal skag mchu/ /gre dbo me bzhi nag sa ri/ /sa ga lag sor snron snrubs dang*/ /chu stod chu smad gro bzhin te/ /byi bzhin 'dir ni bgrang mi bya | | mon gre dang ni mon gru dang*/ khrums stod khrums smad nam gru'o/ /lug glang 'khrig pa karka ṭa/ /seng ge bu mo srang sdig pa/ /gzhu dang chu srin bum pa nya/ khyim ni bcu gnyis zhes bya'o/ /sel ba dang ni mdza' bo dang*/ /tshe ldan pa dang skal bzang dang*/ /bzang po dang ni rab brtan dang*/ /las bzang 'dzin pa gzer 'bras dang*/ /'phel ba nges pa rma chen dang*/ /dga' dang rdo rje dngos grub dang*/ /kun tu ltung dang dpa' bo dang*/ /yongs su bsnun dang zhi ba dang*/ / grub pa bsgrub bya dge ba dang*/ /dkar po tshangs pa dbang po dang*/ /sha 'khon 'dzin pa zhes bya ste/ /sbyor ba nyi shu rtsa bdun no/ /byed pa bdun dang lhag ma ni// gdab pa dang ni byis pa can/ /ye shes dang ni de yi til/ khyim skyes tshong dang bkra shis dang*/ /byed pa bdun po zhes bya ste/

/nag po'i phyogs la dbang ba yin | khyad par gyi ni byed pa bzhi/ /bkra shis dang ni bzhi mdo dang*/ /klu dang mi sdug pa zhes bya/ /dkar phyogs nyin phyed yan chad ni/ /mi sdug pa zhes brjod bya la/ /nyin phyed tshun chad nam phyed ni/ /bdun gyi dang po gdab pa yin// mtshan phyed man chad tshes gnyis ni/ /nyin phyed tshun chad byis pa can/ /de ltar bdun po res kyis 'jug /nag po'i bcu bzhi phyi ma nas/ /bkra shis zhes bya gnam stong gi /phyed lnga yan chad bzhi mdo'o/ /phyed phyi ma nas klu zhes bya/ /de ltar mkhas pas brtags byas la/ /kun la legs par bstan par bya/ /yan lag lnga dang sgra gcan dang*/ /nyi zla 'dzin pa dang bcas pa'i/ /rtsis rnams legs par bstan zin to// //༄༅/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bkra shis la sogs pa'i longs spyod kyi don du nyin zhag gcig gi tshogs bstan pa ni/ zla ba dag pa sum cus bsgyur/ /de la 'das pa'i tshes rnams bsre/ /gnas gsum bzhag pa'i 'og ma la/ /thub pa nam mkha' ris bgos pa'i/ /rnyed pa dbus mar sbyin par bya/ /de la chu dus kyis bgos pa'i/ /rnyed pas steng la dbri bar bya

|| des ni mi gsal nyin zhag sogs/ /gnas gnyis bzhag pa'i 'og ma la// thub pa yis ni bgo bar bya/ /lhag ma de yi nyin bar gyi/ /gza' dang mthun na dag pa yin//mi mthun na ni gcig la sogs/ /ma dag pa la snon 'brid kyis// nyin bar gza' dang mthun par bya/ /de nyid gsal ba'i zhag mchog ste/ / gza' lnga kun gyi thun mong yin/ /mig dmar gsal ba'i nyi ma la/ /ri dang dus dang zla bas bsre/ /ri dang klu dang dus kyis bgo /lhag ma skar mas bsgyur ba la/ /gong gi bgod byed kyis thob pa/ /skar ma yin te lhag ma ni/ /drug cus bsgyur ba thob chu tshod/ /lhag ma drug cus bsgyur ba la/ /thob pa chu srang dag tu 'gyur | | dus kyis bsgyur ba thob pa dbugs/ /de dag gnas gnyis dag tu bzhag | gcig la phyed dang bcu dbri ste/ /med na 'khor lo phyed ni bsre/ / 'khor lo phyed lhag gyur na dor/ /de ltar sngar gyi de bzhin dbri/ /phri ba'i lhag ma drug cus bsgyur/ /'og gi chu tshod steng du bsre/ /mda' dang yon tan zla ba yis | | bgos pa'i thob pas dal rkang bzung*/ /rkang pa zos pa'i sngon ma yis// bgos pa'i lhag ma bsgyur bar bya/ /de la thob pa chu tshod yin/ /lhag ma drug cus bsgyur ba las/ /thob pa chu srang dag tu 'gyur/ /drug gis bsgyur la thob pa dbugs/ /de ltar thob pa de rnams kyis/ /sngar gyi rkang pa'i dbyu gu la/ /snga ma'i cha la zos pa dang*/ /sdom la snon 'brid bya ba dang*/ /phyi ma'i cha la ma zos la | | phri la snon 'brid bya ba ni/ /rim dang rim pa min pas shes/ /skar ma yi ni 'khor lo phyed/ /snon 'brid byas na rim min la/ /snon 'brid ma byas rim pa yin/ /snon 'brid byas nas snon pa ste/ /snon 'brid ma byas 'brid pa yin// dal ba'i dus su bsnan par 'gyur/ /myur ba'i dus su rim yin no/ /ma bsnan na ni snon pa ste/ /rim pa mi bsnan gyur na ni/ /'brid pa yin pa shes par bya//

rim dang rim pa min pas 'di/ /gza' lnga kun la'ang shes par bya/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga bco brgyad bdun/ /phyi ma'i cha la de las bzlog /mig dmar dal ba'i rkang pa yin/ /myur la de nyid gnas gnyis bzhag /gcig gis nyi ma dag pa sbyang*// med na 'khor lo'i phyed ni bsre/ /de nas sbyangs pa'i lhag ma yis/ /myur ba'i rkang pa bzung bar bya/ /zin nas nyi ma'i rkang pa dbri/ /rkang pa zos pa'i sngon ma yin | | nyi ma'i chu tshod bsgyur bar bya/ /de la mkha' dus kyis bgod pa'i/ / thob pa dbyu gu'i gnas su bzhag /lhag ma drug cus bsgyur ba las/ /thob pa chu srang dag tu 'gyur/ /drug gis bsgyur la thob pa dbugs/ /thob pa rnams dang rkang pa yi/ /chu tshod bsres la snon 'brid bya/ /rim pa yin na bsnan bya zhing*/ / rim pa min na dbri bar bya/ /'khor lo phyed bsres rim min la/ /ma bsred pa ni rim pa'o/ /dang por nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang*/ /gnyis gsum bzhi par nyi shu gsum | | lnga dang drug par nyi shu gcig /bdun par bco brgyad brgyad par tshes | | dgu par bcu gcig bcu par gsum/ /de ni snga ma'i cha yin no/ /bcu gcig dang ni sum cu brgyad/ /brgyad cu dang ni lnga bcu gsum/ /mig dmar myur ba'i rkang pa yin/ /nyi mas mig dmar rab sbyang zhing*/ /phur bu dang ni spen pa yi/ /myur ba'i las kyang de bzhin no/ /gza' lhag dang ni pa wa sangs/ / dal ba'i las la nyi ma'i nyid/ /sbyangs pas dal ba'i rkang par bya/ /gza' lhag gsal ba'i nyi ma la/ /mkha' dang nam mkha' zla bas bsgyur/ /me dang nyi ma ri yis dbri/ /ri dang bug pa dang ni ri/ /klu yis bgos pa dor bya zhing*/ / lhag ma skar mas bsgyur ba la/ /gong gi ri sogs kyis bgos pa'i/ /thob pa skar ma'i nges pa yin/ /lhag ma drug cus bsgyur ba las/ /thob pa chu tshod dag tu 'gyur/ /lhag ma drug cus bsgyur ba ni/ /thob pa chu srang gnas su bzhag /drug gis bsgyur la thob pa dbugs/

/gza' lhag nges pa zhes bya ba/ /de ni gnas gzhan dag tu bzhag /gza' lhag dal ba'i don du ni/ /ma dag nyi ma gnas gnyis bzhag /gcig la phyed dang bcu bdun sbyangs/ /med na 'khor lo'i phyed ni bsre/ /des kyang sbyang rgyu ma rnyed na/ /'khor lo thams cad bsre bar bya | | sbyangs nas 'khor lo phyed lhag na/ /'khor lo phyed ni dor bar bya/ / sbyangs pa'i lhag ma drug cus bsgyur/ /'og gi chu tshod steng la bsre/ /mda' dang yon tan zla ba yis/ /bgos pas thob pas rkang pa bzung*/ /rkang pa zos pa'i sngon ma yin/ /chu tshod gnas la bsgyur bar bya/ /mda' la sogs pa thob pa ni// dbyu gu yi ni gnas su bzhag /drug cus bsgyur la thob chu srang*/ /drug gis bsgyur la thob pa dbugs/ /de dag rkang pa'i dbyu gu dang*/ /snon 'brid byas pa'i rim pa dang*/ /rim pa ma yin pa rnams kyis/ /snon pa dang ni sbyang ba ni/ / mig dmar bya ba ji bzhin no/ /phyogs dang ri dang me dang ni/ /phyi ma la ni de las bzlog /gza' lhag dal ba'i rkang pa yin//myur ba'i rkang pa bya ba'i phyir// dal ba de nyid gnas gnyis bzhag /dang po rnyed pa de bzhag pa'i/ /gza' lhag rang gi nges pa de/ /dal ba gcig gis sbyang bar bya/ /sbyangs pa'i lhag mas rkang pa bzung*/ /rkang pa zos pa'i sngon ma yis/ /'og gi chu tshod bsgyur bar bya/ /de la drug cus thob pa ni/ /dbyu gu yin te lhag ma la/ /drug cus bsgyur ba thob pa ni/ /chu srang yin te lhag ma ni/ /drug gis bsgyur la thob pa dbugs | | de dag rkang pa'i dbyu gur byas/ /rim dang rim pa ma yin pas/ / dal ba gcig dang snon dbrid bya/ /bcu drug lan gnyis bco lnga dang*/ /bcu bzhi bcu gsum bcu gcig bdun/ /lnga dang nam mkha' zhes bya ba/ /snga ma'i cha yi rkang pa yin/ /bzhi dang bcu gcig nyi shu dang*/ /nyi shu brgyad dang sum cu bzhi | | gza' lhag myur ba'i rkang pa'o/ /phur bu gsal ba'i nyi ma la/

/mkha' dang nam mkha' ro dang ni/ /mig gis phur bu'i don du dbri/ /so dang me dang chu gter gyis/ /bgos pas thob pa dbri byas la/ /lhag ma skar mas bsgyur ba las | | sngar gyi bgod byed kyis thob pa/ /skar ma'i gnas su bzhag par bya/ / lhag ma drug cus bsgyur ba las/ /thob pa chu tshod dag tu 'gyur/ /drug cus bsgyur la thob chu srang*/ /drug gis bsgyur la thob pa dbugs/ /de nyid gnas gnyis dag tu bzhag /gcig la skar ma bcu gnyis sbyangs/ /lhag ma drug cus bsgyur byas la/ /mda' dang yon tan zla ba yis/ /bgos pas thob pas rkang pa bzung | | rkang pa zos pa'i sngon ma yis/ /lhag ma bsgyur ba las thob pa/ /dbyu gu'i gnas su bzhag par bya/ /drug cus bsgyur la thob chu srang*/ /drug gis bsgyur la thob pa dbugs/ /de dag rkang pa'i dbyu gur byas/ /sngar gyi dal ba'i gnas gcig la/ /rim dang rim pa ma yin las/ /snon dang sbyong bar shes par bya | | drag po dang ni dgu dang me/ /phyi ma'i cha la de las bzlog /phur bu dal ba'i rkang pa yin/ /slar yang myur ba'i rkang pa ni/ /dal pa de nyid gnas gnyis bzhag | gcig gis nyi ma dag par sbyang*/ /sbyangs pa'i lhag mas rkang pa bzung*// zos pa'i sngon mas chu tshod bsgyur/ /de la drug cus thob pa ni/ /dbyu gu'i gnas su bzhag par bya/ /drug cus bsgyur la thob chu srang*/ /drug gis bsgyur la thob pa dbugs/ /thob pa rnams ni rkang pa yi/ /dbyu gur byas te gcig shos la/ / rim dang rim pa ma yin pas/ /snon dang sbyong bar shes par bya/ /bcu pa lan gnyis dgu dang brgyad/ /drug dang drug dang gnyis dang gcig /phyi ma'i cha la gsum dang drug /dgu dang bcu gcig bcu drug bdun/ /phur bu myur ba'i rkang pa yin/ /pa wa sangs kyi don du ni/ /gsal ba'i zhag la bcu pa yis/ /chu bo dang ni klu yis dbri/ /ri dang chu bo mig dang mig /de yis bgos pa dbri bar bya | | lhag ma skar mas bsgyur ba la/

/gong gi bgod byed kyis thob pa/ /skar ma'i gnas su bzhag par bya/ /drug cus bsgyur thob chu tshod dang*/ /drug cus bsgyur la thob chu srang*/ /drug gis bsgyur la dbugs zhes bya/ /pa wa sangs te logs shig bzhag /dal ba'i rkang pa btsal ba'i phyir/ /nyi mar tshes sbyin gnas gnyis bzhag /gcig la skar mar drug dbri zhing*/ /med na 'khor lo phyed bsres la/ /sngar bzhin phri ste lhag ma la/ /drug cu yis ni bsgyur bar bya/ / 'og gi chu tshod steng du bsre/ /mda' dang yon tan zla ba yis/ /bgos pas thob pas rkang pa bzung*/ /rkang pa zos pa'i sngon ma yis/ /lhag ma bsgyur la des thob pa/ /dbyu gu'i gnas su bzhag par bya/ /drug cus bsgyur la thob chu srang*// drug gis bsgyur la thob pa dbugs/ /thob pa rnams dang rkang pa yis/ /dbyu gur byas te snon 'brid ni/ /rim dang rim pa ma yin bya/ /mda' dang chu bo zla ba ste/ /phyi ma la ni de las bzlog /dal ba'i rkang par shes par bya/ /pa wa sangs kyi myur ba la/ /dal ba de nyid gnas gnyis bzhag /gcig gis sngar gyi nges par sbyang*/ /sbyangs pa'i lhag mas rkang pa bzung*/ /rkang pa zos pa'i sngon ma yis/ /dbyu gu'i gnas la bsgyur bar bya/ /de la mkha' dus kyis thob pa | | dbyu gu'i gnas su bzhag par bya/ /lhag ma drug cus bsgyur ba las/ / thob pa chu srang dag tu 'gyur/ /drug gis bsgyur la thob pa dbugs/ /de dag rkang pa'i dbyu gur bcas/ /sngar gyi dal ba'i gnas gcig la/ /rim dang rim pa ma yin pas//snon dang sbyong bar shes par bya/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga lan gsum dang*// nyi shu rtsa bzhi gnas gnyis bzhag /nyi shu rtsa gnyis gnas gnyis te/ /bco brgyad pa dang bco lnga pa/ /klu ni snga ma'i rkang pa yin/ /ro dang sum cu dgu bcu dgu | | bdun cu rtsa gsum phyi ma'i cha/ /pa wa sangs kyi myur rkang yin/ /lhag ma'i bya ba gza' lhag bzhin/ /spen pa gsal ba'i nyin zhag la/

/mkha' dang lag pa klu dang ni/ /rig byed kyis ni phri ba yi/ /lhag ma drug ro ri dang ni/ / nam mkha' zla ba dag gis bag /bgos pa'i lhag ma skar mas bsgyur/ /de la gong gi bgod byed kyis/ /thob par skar ma'i gnas su bzhag /lhag ma drug cus bsgyur ba las/ /thob pa chu tshod gnas su shes/ /drug cus bsgyur la thob chu srang*/ /drug gis bsgyur la thob pa dbugs/ /rnyed pa de dag gnas gnyis bzhag | gcig la skar ma bco brgyad dbri/ /med na 'khor lo phyed bsre'o/ / gal te med na 'khor lo kun/ /bsres la gong gi de bzhin dbri/ /phri ba'i lhag ma 'khor lo phyed/ /lhag na de ni dor bar bya//'di ni gza' lnga kun la 'jug /lhag ma mkha' dus kyis bsgyur la/ /'og gi chu tshod steng du blug /mda' dang yon tan zla ba yis/ /bgos pa thob pas rkang pa bzung*/ /rkang pa zos pa'i sngon ma yis/ /lhag ma'i gnas la bsgyur bar bya/ /gong gi bgod byed kyis thob pa/ /dbyu gu'i gnas su bzhag par bya/ /drug cus bsgyur las thob chu srang | | drug gis bsgyur las thob pa dbugs/ /de ltar thob pa rnams dang ni// rkang pa yi ni dbyu gu'i cha/ /sngon ma'i cha la zos dang sdom/ /phyi ma'i cha la ma zos la || phri ste snon 'brid bya ba ni/ /rim dang rim pa min pas shes/ /nyi shu gnyis dang bco lnga drug /phyi ma la ni de las bzlog /spen pa dal ba'i rkang pa yin/ / myur ba'i rkang pa btsal ba'i phyir/ /dal ba de nyid gnas gnyis bzhag /gcig gi nyi ma dag la sbyang*/ /sbyangs pa'i lhag ma rkang pa mtshon/ /rkang pa zos pa'i sngon ma yis/ /'og gi chu tshod bsgyur bar bya/ /de la mkha' dus kyis thob pa | | dbyu gu'i gnas su bzhag par bya/ /drug cus bsgyur la thob chu srang*/ / drug gis bsgyur las thob pa dbugs/ /de ltar thob par rnams dang ni/ /rkang pa dang ni dbyu gur bcas/ /dal ba yi ni gnas gcig la/ /snon dang sbyong bar byed pa ni/

/rim dang rim pa min par shes/ /ro dang 'byung ba mda' rig byed// sde pa lag pa mig nam mkha'/ /phyi ma'i cha la mig dang bzhi/ /'byung ba ro dang klu yon tan/ /spen pa myur ba'i rkang pa yin/ /gza' lnga so so'i rtsis rdzogs so || || grags pa mi dbang gis bsdebs nyung ngu'i rgyud/ /shin tu gsal min gcig na'ang ma rdzogs shing*/ /sdeb sbyor byings che myur du rtogs min sa/ / 'dir ni blo dman bzung phyir gsal bar bgyis/ /dge ba des ni nam mkha'i mtha' gtugs pa'i/ /sems can thams cad blo gros mchog gyur pas/ /ji bzhin ji snyed thugs su chud gyur pa'i/ /kun mkhyen rgyal po'i go 'phang thob par shog/ //༄༅/ /dpal ldan shambha la yi yul/ /grong khyer bye ba dgu bcu drug /rgyal po'i pho brang kā la par/ /sprul pa'i rgyal po 'byung ba ni/ /dpal ldan phyag na rdo rje dang*/ /sa snying gshin rje mthar byed dang*/ /sgrib pa thams cad rnam sel ba//dzaṃ bha la dang nor sbyin dang*/ /nam mkha'i snying po 'jam pa'i dbyangs// 'jig rten mgon po rim ji bzhin/ /gshin rje gshes sogs khro bo bcu/ /byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin du/ /gzhan yang bcu gsum rim pa ni/ /kal kyi'i rigs su gyur pa yin/ /zla bzang lha dbang gzi brjid dang*/ /lha sbyin lha yi dbang phyug dang*/ /sna tshogs lus dang bde byed dang*/ /grags pa pad dkar rim pa bzhin/ /nyi ma'i 'od stong rgyal po yi/ /grags pa man chad kal kyi'i rigs || kal kyi'i grags pa zhes bya dang*/ /kal kyi'i pad dkar gnyis pa ste// snyigs ma'i bzang po gsum pa'o/ /de bzhin bzhi pa rnam rgyal lo/ /bshes bzang rin chen dmar po'i phyag khyab 'jug sbas pa bdun pa ste/ /nyi ma grags dang shin tu bzang*/ /rgya mtsho'i nyi ma rnam rgyal dang*/ /sdig can nyi ma bcu gnyis pa/ /sna tshogs gzugs dang zla ba'i 'od/ /mtha' yas dang ni sa skyong dang | | dpal skyong dang ni seng ge gnon/

/ngo mtshar che dang 'gag med dang*/ / mi yi seng ge dbang phyug che/ /mtha' yas rnam rgyal snyigs ma can/ /de yi sras ni 'khor lo che/ /drag po kal kyi 'byung 'gyur bas/kla klo'i chos ni mthar byed de | | byang chub sems dpa' 'di dag yin/ /sprul pa'i rgyal po 'byung ba ni/ / phyag na rdo rje zla bzang khyod/ /sa yi snying po lha dbang ste/ /gshin rje mthar byed gzi brjid can/ /sgrib pa kun sel zla ba sbyin/ /dzaṃ bha la ni lha yi dbang*/ / nor can sna tshogs gzugs can te/ /nam mkha'i snying po pad byed lha/ /de yi btsun mo sna tshogs gzugs/ /de la 'jam dbyangs grags pa ste/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang pad dkar po/ /nyi ma'i 'od stong rgyal po ni/ /bgegs mthar byed pa'i sprul pa ste/ /de ltar rgyal rabs rnam pa bcu/ /de las kal kyi zhes bya'i ming*/ khro bo bcu dang de bzhin du/ /byang chub sems dpa' bcu gsum ni// rim pa bzhin du 'byung ba de/ /gshin gshed rtsod pa'i rnam rgyal lo/ /phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa ni/ /drag po kal kyi zhes bya'i bar/ khro bo bcu dang de bzhin du/ / byang chub sems dpa' re re spel/ /mjug tu byang chub sems dpa' gsum/

/ rim pa bzhin du 'byung ba yin/ /sprul pa'i rgyal po re re zhing*/ /lo ni brgya phrag lhag pa ru/ /seng ge'i khri la bzhugs nas ni/ /chos kyi 'jig rten skyong bar mdzad | | des na rgyal bas bsngags pa yi/ /shambha la yi yul du ni/ /dpal ldan rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud/ /nam yang nub par mi 'gyur ro/ /ji bzhin ji snyed ma lus bstan mdzad pa'i/ /dpal ldan dam pa dang po'i de bzhin du/ /nyung ngu'i rgyud dang de bzhin rnam 'grel rnams/ /gsung dang bsdud mdzad rab tu 'byed mdzad pa'i/ /dam chos rgyal dang sras la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /ji srid nam mkha' mi 'jig bar du ni/ /'gro kun bu gcig bzhin du rtag skyong ba/ /dpal ldan kā la par 'khrungs rgyal po'i mchog /sprul pa'i mi dbang rnams la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /nyung ngu'i rgyud rgyal rnam 'grel dang bcas pa/ /'phags pa'i yul du gsal bar mdzad pa po/ /dpal ldan rdo rje slob dpon rtse lung pa'i/ /zhabs pad dri ma med la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /shākya'i dge bsnyen grags pa rgyal mtshan la | | rtsis dang mi dbang lo rgyus bstod par bcas/ /dang po'i las la phan 'dogs 'khor lo 'bar/ /shākya 'bar gyis gsol ba btab nas bris/ /de las byung ba'i dge ba dri ma med/ /nyi ma skyon bral lta bu'i 'od zer gyis/ /'gro ba kun gyi blo yi padmo'i mchog /rab rgyas sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur bar shog /dpal ldan sa skya'i dgon pa dam par ni/ /glang lo karka ṭar gnas zla ba yi/ / skar ma rgyal stod nyi ma dros chen na/ /legs par bsdebs te 'di ni tshar bar bgyis | | dpal ldan dam pa dang po dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud kyi rgyal po gsal bar byed pa don la 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i tshig le'u byas pa/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang gnyis su med pa'i thugs mnga' ba/ 'gran zla dang bral ba'i mkhas pa chen po | snyan ngag mkhas pa rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa rdzogs so//

//nyi dag skar ma mkha' ros bsgyur/ /chu tshod bsres la mda' yon zlas// rnyed pa 'das pa'i rā shi'i grangs/ /lhag ma mkha' ri bsgres pa la/ /chu srang bsres la dus ro dang*/ /mig gis rnyed pa 'das pa'i zhag /lhag ma mkha' dus kyis bsgyur la/ /mda' yon zlas rnyed 'das chu tshod/ /lhag ma mkha' ros bsgyur ba la/ /rnyed pa chu srang lhag ma ni/ /dus kyis bsgres la thob pa dbugs// lo dag bzhi brgyas bsgyur ba la/ /srin po nor zlar bcas pa yis/ /lo dag gis ni sbyang bar bya//de la ri zla me yis dbye/ /lhag ma drug cus bsgyur ba la/ / rnyed pa chu tshod gnas su bzhag /steng 'og mig dang sum cu bsre/ /'og ma drug cus bgos te sbyin/ /lhag ma chu tshod steng ma ni/ /thub pas phye ba'i lhag ma gza' | | dag pa'i lo la 'dod pas sbyin/ /gnas gnyis steng ma bzhi brgyas bsgyur | | de la 'og mas sbyang bar bya/ /slar yang klu dang mig gis dbri// lhag ma ri zla me yis dbye/ /thob pa gza' yi gnas su bzhag /lhag ma drug cus bsgyur ba la/ /rnyed pa chu tshod steng 'og chu/ /mig dang sum cu bsres nas 'og / drug cus bgos lhag chu tshod de/ /steng ma thub pas bgos lhag gza'/ /lo dag gnas gnyis steng ma la/ /gzugs lag bsres la bzhi brgyas bsgyur// 'og mar mkha' me bsres pas sbyang*/ /de la thub zla me yis dbye/ /rnyed pa gza' gnas lhag ma ni/ /drug cus bsgyur nas rnyed chu tshod/ /steng 'og mig dang sum cu bsre/ /lhag na gong du 'bud par bya/ /ma dor ma brgal myur ba shar | | dor la ma brgal 'khyol po nub/ /brgal ba ma dor dal ba lho/ / brgal ba dor ba drang po byang*/ /paṇḍi ta zla ba gzhon nu'i rtsis lugs yin zhes go lung ba smra'o// // ༄༅/ /pa sangs spen sa zla lhag chu/ /nyi mig me la phur sgra rlung | | sa gnyis 'phrad pa dngos grub sbyor/ /chu nang 'phrad pa bdud rtsi'i sbyor// sa chu 'phrad pa lang tsho'i sbyor/

/me nang 'phrad pa 'phel 'gyur sbyor/ /rlung nang 'phrad pa phun tshogs sbyor/ /me rlung 'phrad pa stobs ldan sbyor/ /chu rlung 'phrad pa mi mthun sbyor/ /sa me 'phrad pa sreg pa'i sbyor/ /me chu 'phrad pa 'chi sbyor yin | | de ltar bzang gsum so thub gsum/ /ngan gsum tha chad gcig dang bcus | | bya ba thams cad bzang ngan byed// // ༄༅/ /smra sgo mtshon cha'i mchan rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ bā tsa na mu kha yu dho pa ma nā ma/ bod skad du/ smra ba'i sgo mtshon cha lta bu zhes bya ba 'i tshigs su bcad pa zer/ smra ba'i mchog thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dge sbyong dang*/ bram ze dang*/ lha dang*/ bdud la sogs pa rigs pa dang ldan par smra ba rnams kyi/ mchog gtso bo sangs rgyas/ la phyag 'tshal ( 1 ) nas*/ / gang gi don du ( 3 ) smra ba'i rgyu dang rkyen gyi/ yan lag kun/ rdzogs don du/ / gang ( 4 ) ngag gi 'du byed gang yin pa/ de yi/ / rgyu'i tshogs pa gang gis bdag gis bshad ( 2 ) par bya/ khog pa mgrin pa rkan dang lce/ /sna dang spyi bo so dang mchu/ / gnas 'di rnams spyi bo'i cha nas 'byung ba/ dang re re'i gnas 'di dag so so las yi ge so so'i sgra shas cher 'byung bas/ cha dag las | | phrad dang cung zad phrad pa dang*/ /dog pa dang ni yangs pa nas/ / 'di dag las sgra ji lta bu dag 'byung zhe na drang po a/ sgreng e/ dang bkug pa i/ dang*/ /bstod pa o| dang ni smad pa u/ dang*/ /bsgrims ṛ/ dang glod l̥/ pa'i nga ro 'byung*/ ༈ / de dag las dbyangs yig bcu drug ji ltar 'byung zhe na drang po bkug dang smad pa dang*/ / bsgrims pa dang ni glod pa lnga/ las/ /gwar ring po/ dang tswang thung ngu gnyis/ gis phye ba sa bcu/ dang | | sgreng e/ dang bsgrengs te bkug pa ai/ dang*/ /bstod o/ dang bstod de smad pa auau/ dang*/ /sna ldan aṃ/ rnam par bcad pa aḥ yis/ /nga ro bcu drug dag tu 'dod

|| ༈ a la sogs pa gsum gyis nga ro dag la/ gis gsal byed bco brgyad du ji ltar 'gyur ba/ ni//drang po bkug dang smad pa la/ / sgra'i 'dren pa ring po dang shin tu ring po dang*/ thung ngu dang*/ gsum yod de/ /de dag re re/ la 'ang*/ che 'bring rnam pa gsum/ / gsum dang*/ de ltar/ dgu la/ sna dang*/ ldan pa dang mi ldan pa gnyis gnyis te/ bco brgyad do/ / dbyangs kyi yi ge la gsal byed spang zhing bsal bar bya ba 'di lta ste/ /sgreng ba dang bstod pa la rang bzhin gyis thung ba med ste/ / de bsal bas drug drug la sna dang ldan mi ldan gyis sgrim dang glod pa rang bzhin gyis ring po med de de bsal bas/ drug po de dag la sna dang ldan mi ldan gnyis gnyis phye bas pa'o/ /bcu gnyis yin te brgya rtsa gnyis/ /spyir ka lta bu gcig la gong gi rnams kyi steng du thun mong gi 'byung gnas brgyad dang ni rkyen gyi byed pa gang rung gcig ste dgu bsnan pas brgya dang bcu rtsa gcig /rang gnas su shas cher 'byung ba miX bgrangs na de/ dang ni bcu gnyis te/ /yi ge ka lta bu/ gcig gi rnam pa'i cha/ /ngag gi 'du byed tshogs pa'o// spyir rnam pa de snyed yod pa las dus gcig tu du 'byung zhe na ni bcu gcig snga ma dgu dang che 'bring chung gsum las gang rung gcig dang ring thung gsum las gang rung gcig ste gam//sna ldan na ni bcu gnyis te/ /rang gi gnas dang bcu gsum mo/ /mtshon 'debs pa dang*/ gar dang las byed dang*/ / rkang pa'i stabs 'gros dang*/ lta stangs bye brag de/ dag / la| rkang lag mig gi 'gyur bag gis/ /lus kyi 'du byed sna tshogs rtsom pa na drang po la sogs pa/ bdun po 'byung ba/ ni/ / lta stangs la sbyar na/ yul gcig la lta ba'i tshe mgo mi 'gyur bas thad kar blta dang lta ba'i gnas nas/ gyen du blta/ /de bzhin du phyogs gzhan nas bskor zhing*| bzlog ste blta ba dang*/ / mig 'phang*/ bstod de blta dang

mig phang*/ smad de blta/ / ba| mig gis bsgrims dang glod de lta ba bdu gyis ngag gi 'du byed bdun mtshon pa/ ltar/ / gar la sogs pa de bzhin te/ /lus kyi 'du shes bdun po ltar/ /ngag gi 'du byed de bzhin te drang por drang pas ni a dang ldan par 'gyur ba la sogs pa'o// no/ / bdun po de ston pa'i yi ge'i/ dbyibs dang*/ kyi de dag gzhag pa'i/ gnas lugs kyang*/ / drang po'i yi ge ni mda' lta bu/ dang bsgreng ba/ bse ru bkug pa/ glang chen sna/ / bstod pa gdugs dang smad pa skyes bu'i/ rkang rten lta bu dang*/ / bsgrims pa/ me ri glod pa/ chu yi dkyil 'khor ltar/ / mtshan ma de dag gi gnas lugs gang zhe na/ drang po'i brda ni thad ka ra mtshon pa/ bse ru zur dang glang po'i sna zur logs dang*/ / gdugs steng rkang rten 'og me ri dang chu'i dkyil 'khor gnyis ni yi ge rang gi lus mtshon pa/ rnams la/ /gnas pa'i brda yis/ 'dir ngag gi 'du byed bdun mtshon par shes par bya/ / bskul ba'i rgyu des bstan brda can 'byung ba na/ / ( kha ) lcags rnams g.yo ba/ la ni dper na/ ( ka ) khab len gyi dbang gis/ ( ga ) bzhin/ /rnam rtog gi dbang gis rlung lus la gnas pa bskul nas des sgra 'byung ba'i/ gnas rnams g.yo/ / rnam par rtog pas ji ltar rlung bskyed ce na ji ltar gnas gzhi med bzhin du/ / dper na bya nam mkha' la 'phur ba'i tshe/ 'dab ma/ bskyod pas rlung 'byung ba/ ltar/ / ming dang ming can 'brel ba'i rnam par rtog pa gzhan la go bar byed pa'i blo/ sa bskyod pas na/ /bā ya ta zhes bya ba'i rlung*/ /lus thams cad la khyab par gnas pa rab tu g.yo zhing ldang bar 'gyur/ / bskyod pa'i rgyus g.yo rlung de/ rab tu g.yos pa yis/ / ci 'gyur zhe na/ byed pa rnams/ kun tu skyod par byed la de bskyod pas/ na/ /dog pa/ dang yangs pa'i gnas rnams su/ / phrad dang cung zad phrad par byed/ / gnas dang byed pa phrad pa/ de tshe ni

lhan cig 'byung ba'i rgyu| shwa swa zhes pa'i/ /rlung bugs te de/ dang sgra/ lhan cig 'byung ba ste/ / kun 'gro'i rgyu ji ltar gzugs thams cad/ la 'byung ba bzhis/ bzhin/ / du yi ge thams cad la dbyangs yig bcu drug dang gsal byed bco brgyad kyis khyab pas/ nga ro la ni brten bzhin du/ / 'byung*/ skal mnyam gyi rgyu rnam par/ rtog pa/ rang gi gzung cha don spyi de dang*/ snang ba'i/ cha de dang gcig / ( 1 ) las/ / ( 3 ) gzugs brnyan 'byung ba/ bzhin du ( 2 ) cha mnyam du sgra spyir snang ba skye// ba'o| |sgra 'byung ba'i ( ka ) gnas rnams dang ni phrad pa la sogs pa'i byed ( kha ) pa dang*/ / ( ga ) rnam par rtog dang bā ya ta dang ni shwa swa'i rlung ( nga ) gnyis dang*/ / ( cha ) nga ro bcu drug gsal byed bco brgyad/ rang snang ba'i gzung cha/ yis/ / ( ja ) rgyu bdun po des ngag gi 'du byed kun tu skyed/ /rgyu bdun dag las 'byung ba ni/ / ( ka ) gnas ka rnams dril bu'i sbubs dang 'dra bar sgra rnams kyi gnas/ gzhi yi rgyu yin te/ /byed ( kha ) pa ni dril bu'i lce dang 'dra ste skul zhing*/ 'byin par byed pa'i rgyu/ /de ( ga ) bzhin rnam rtog ni skyes bu/ skul ba'i dang 'dra bar byed pa po yin pas/ rgyu/ /ji ( nga ) ltar dper na/ shing g.yo bar byed pa/ la rlung gis| bzhin du/ /byed pa rnams/ bskyod par byed pa'i/ rgyu bā ya ta 'i rlung gis 'o/ /skyes ( ca ) bu dang ni bzhon pa dang lhan cig 'byung ba/ bzhin/ / du/ lhan cig 'byung ba'i/ rgyu ni shwa swa/ / 'i rlung dbugs ni sgra dang*/ nga ( cha ) ro rnams dang gsal byed gnyis/ ni/ / brjod pa/ kun la/ tu khyab par 'gro ba sa/ 'i rgyu/ / rnam rtog don spyi snang ba'i/ cha dang*/ 'dra bar yi ge rnams kyi sgra/ 'byung ba ni/ / skal pa mnyam pa'i rgyu zhes bya// // de la yi ge'i/ gdangs kyi bye brag ni/ / mi 'dra ba rgyu rnams dag gis phye ba ste/ / rgyu mi 'dra ba sngon du song ba las gdangs mi 'dra ba 'byung ba/

ra rig par bya/ /de la rgyu dang rang bzhin no/ / ni/ nga ro 'i rtsa ba/ drang po a/ las yi ge 'di rnams/ gyur pa/ / ste/ 'di ltar ka sogs sde nas bzung ste/ rim bzhin du/ /sde pa lnga tshan/ lnga dag dang anta mthar gnas bzhi/ stha/ /uṣma dro ba bzhi/ ṣa dang mthar zad kṣa/ du/ /da ེ rnams gnas so so la brten pas/ kyi yi ge sum cu bzhi/ / yig 'bru so sor gsal bas/ ming dang ni gsal zhing drag pas| pho zhes grags pa ste/ / gnyan na nye ba'i phyir ro// de la dang po ka 'i sde pa dang*/ / uṣma'i ṣa yi bzhi pa ha/ ni/ /bcad par tsheg drag bcas pa mgrin pa las/ /gnyis pa tsa'i sde/ dang ni antastha'i/ /dang po ya/ uṣma'i dang po sha rnams/ /rkan las rab tu 'byung ba yin/ /gsum pa ṭa'i sde/ dang ni antastha'i/ /gnyis pa ra/ uṣma'i gnyis pa ṣa| rnams/ /spyi bo 'i thad ka'i rkan/ las ni rab tu 'byung*/ /bzhi pa ta'i sde/ dang ni antastha'i/ /gsum pa la/ uṣma'i gsum pa sa/ rnams/ /so yi cha las kun tu 'byung | | lnga pa pa'i sde/ dang ni antastha'i/ /bzhi pa wa/ mchu las 'byung ba yin/ / mthar zad kṣa/ mgul dang spyi bo las/ /sde pa/ lnga po/ dag la re re la'ang*/ lnga lnga yang*// yod pa las/ dang po ka tsa ṭa ta pa rnams ni rang*/ rang gi gnas nas/ drag po ra brjod pa las 'byung*| ste/ /gnyis pa kha tsha ṭha tha pha rnams ni/ 'bring du drangs pas/ dang spyi bo'i sgra'i/ cha/ / phrad pa las 'byung*/ gsum pa ga dza ḍa da ba/ rnams ni zhan par drangs/ pa ste/ / ka zhan par drangs nas/ a dang sbyar nas gar gyur pa lta bu'o// mahā chen por/ prā srog gnyis/ ṇa 'thug po/ zhes bya ba/ / bzhi pa gha dzha ḍha dha bha rnams ni/ rang rang gi gnas dang*/ khong pa'i sgra'i cha la brten/ nas so/ / zla'i yin a nu rjes su sna ldan/ swa ra dbyangs/ zhes bya ba'i/ /lnga pa nga nya ṇa na ma rnams ni/ rang rang ga ིgnas dang*/ sna 'i sgra phrad pa/ las 'byung*/ /mgul pa sna dang klad pa'i sbubs/ / las 'byung ba'i yi ge rnams/ dog pa 'i rkyen can/

yin te yangs pa 'i rkyen gyis bkyed pa de las/ gzhan | | pa'o/ rkan dang so dang lce dang mchu/ / nas 'byung ba rnams ni/gnas phan tshun phrad pa yin te de dag las/ gzhan pa ni cung zad phrad pa las 'byung bar/ shes bya/ /gnas chu'i yi ge grangs mang po/ ji snyed yod/ kyang*/ /nga ro gcig gis bcings pa āoXṃ dang hūm̐ lta bu/ la// de la'ang yi ge gcig ces brjod/ /shin tu phra ba'i rnam pa'i cha/ / gsal byed bco brgyad cha lta bu/ de la'ang yi ge gcig ces brjod/ bya/ / yi ge'i sgra 'di dag la 'dren pa'i cha/ /

yis dbye na/ zla'i min alpa chung ba phaṭa lta bu'i yi ge prā ṇa gnyis gcig gi yun brjod pas stobs chung ba/ yin/ /mahā prā ṇa gha lta bu yi ge gcig gnyis kyi yun du brjod pas stobs che ba/ yin/ /a nu swa ra khaX la sogs pa dbugs/ rngubs pa/ pa las/ 'i sgra/ / 'byung bas rjes su nga ro/ bi sardza niḥ tsheg drag te drag tu byed pas/ bcad pa'o/ /hra swa zhes pa yi ge gang rung*| tha mal du brjod pa'i/ sgra yin pas thung ngu'o// te/ /dīrgha dag ni yi ge gnyis kyi yun// du brjod pas ring po/ plu ta ni de bzhin gsum/ / gyi yun du brjod pas shin tu ring po/ u dātta ni yi ge gnyis/ / gcig la gcig btags pas de chen po gcig brjod pa/ a nu dātta yi ge phyed kyi| cha phaṭa'i ṭa lta bu/ sgra brjod pa chung ngu*/ yin/ /swa ri ta ni rang sgra sor bzhag pa/ 'o/ / klad kor dang sna ldan a nu swa ra'i cha/ /a ldan a med ces bya ba/ / lar a med pa ni med kyi 'on kyang a shas che ba dag dang chung ba'i ming*/ /drang po a las gyur pa/ dag las gnas dang cha yod pa ji lta bar/ / i sogs nga ro gzhan bsgreng ba la sogs pa/ la yang de bzhin te/ /de la cung zad gnas mi 'dra ba'i/ cha ni/ /rkan dang mgul ba'i cha dag las | | sgreng e/ dang bkug pa i/ 'i nga ro 'byung*/ /de bzhin mchu las bstod o| smad u/ do/ /bsgrims pa ṛ/ spyi bo'i cha las te/ /glod pa l̥/ dag ni so yin no// dbyangs 'di dag gis ni bcings pa na/ /cha ni sngon du drang po'i skabs su/ brjod pa bzhin | | mi i e/ te mu u o/ do ṛ l̥ yi/ / bkug pa la sogs pa'i sgra yi cha dang ci rigs sbyar/ /a yi drang po/ cha ste sngar/ ni bdun du dpyad/ / do// lhag ma i la sogs pa ni a'i bye brag yin pas na a'i/ rnam pa'i cha zhes bya/ / 'o//cha de'ang gnyis las de dag so so la yod na/ re re'i cha yin te/ /gang yang yi ge du ma/ phan tshun gcig la gcig

brten pa oṃ lta bu|1 ni/ / 3 kun tu khyab phyir 2 spyi yi cha/ / ste/ de dag yi ge'i bye brag gi dbye ba'o ste/ / yi ge ni ming lta bur yi ge'i rnam grangs gzhan brjod pas mi go ba/ du ma med pa dang*/ / yi ge du ma 'dus pa la brten nas ming dang*/ tshig gi ngo bo 'grub cing*/ gsal bar byed pa dang*/ / yi ge du ma 'dus pas ming gi rten byas te don gyi ngo bo brjod pa la sogs pa/ rnams brjod par byed pa'i phyir/ /yi ge zhes ni brjod pa yin/ / gang gi sgo nas zhe na rang bzhin ngo bo'am dngos kyi byed/ las dang brgyud pa'i/ dgos ched kyi/ / sgo nas/ nges tshig yin te go rim bzhin | | sbyar ro/ ༈ /kā ya zhes pa'i sgra tshogs dang lus dang 'dus pa yi/ / gsum ka la 'jug pas de rnams kyang ming gi rnam grangs dag ste de bzhin du ming gi skabs su yang sbyar/ / ro| | ji ltar rgyu rdul du ma 'dus pa/ las gong bu bzhin/ /yi ge 'dus par gyur pa na// de nyid dang gzhan du brjod du med pa'i ming ni rab tu 'grub par 'gyur/ / ngo bo gang zhig rnam cha yi ge du ma/ 'dus pa yis/ / brjod bya don gyi ngo bo nyid brjod na/ /rnam cha yi ge mang ngam nyung gyur kyang*/ /de ni don la blo khrid par byed pas/ ming zhes rab tu brjod// de yang dbye ba/ ming gi dbye na/ thog ma grub pa'i/ dang*/ /rjes su sgrub pa 'i ming*/ rnam pa gnyis | | so so'i ngo bo la brten thog ma sgra bshad rgyu med par bla thabs su btags pas/ 'dod rgyal ming yin te/ /rjes sgrub dag gi dbye ba/ ni don ldan pa/ dang*/ / mi ldan pa rnam pa gnyis gar 'dod pa yin// so so'i ngo bo de dag ni bshad rgyu'i/ nges tshig yod pa dang*/ med pa'i do/ /gang zhig dngos po gzhan gyi ming*/ la ma brten par/ / dngos po de'i ming du/ bla dwags zer/ thabs su dang po nyid du/ gang byas thog ma'o/ / grub pa'i ming de la brten nas de'i rjes byed/

pa rjes sgrub pa/ /'dod rgyal dang bshad pa don ldan gnyis su 'dod// rtsod spong 'dod rgyal dag tu mtshungs pa la dang po la grub pa zhes zer ba ni/ mod kyi/ / sngar grub pa'i ming la/ ma brten phyir na grub pa ste/ /ming gzhan gang la'ang ma brten pa// ra thog ma brda byas pa de ming 'di rigs sam mi rigs ces/ gzhan gyis sgrub pa'am dgag pa'i sgo nas | brgal 'gal zer/ ba med phyir ro/ / ming gnyis kyi khyad par gyi dpes 'thad pa sgrub pa'i rigs pa tshul gsum pa'i rtags/ dag /chos nyid kyi rigs pa/ la ni brten pa bzhin | | rjes su sgrub pa/ don ldan ming yang de bzhin du/ /'dod rgyal thog ma 'i ming | nyid la brten/ / nas brjod pa'o/ / rjes su sgrub pa'i 'dod rgyal la nges tshig yod med kyis bshad na ni/ / rjes su log par sgrub par 'gyur ba'i/ phyir nges tshig gzhag / de'i phyir 'dod rgyal ba/ thog ma'i ming gang yin/ / pa de/ nges tshig bshad pa'i gzhi med de dper na/ chos nyid kyi rigs pa la sgrub pa'i rten gzhan med pa/ bzhin/ / dbye ba de la brten pa/ don ldan pa'i/ nges tshig ni/ /de yin pa'i/ phyir de la de skad ces zer ba/ dang de la de/ yod phyir | | rdasaX lta bu/ de la de/ phan phyir sman rkang nad lta bu/ de 'dis byed phyir/ /der 'di la/ bya'i phyir dang de dang*/ 'dra'i phyir/ / ser po khra rkang lta bu/ de 'i don/ de yin pa/ 'i phyir dang da ེ'i ngo bo/ nyid de yin pa'i/ phyir/ /de dngos po/ yi ming ni de skad ces/ / zhing pa zhes pa lta bu ldan pa la sogs pa'i sgra rtags kyi sgo yod pa/ 'am med kyang rung*/ /skabs kyi shugs sam/ mthu yis nges tshig brjod/ / bsdu ba yin dang ngo bo dang po/ sgrub pa bdun pa/ dang*/ / brgyad pa dngos po'i rkyen gsum/ ni dngos kyi ming*/ /lhag ma lnga po ni/ btags pa 'i ming*| zhes bya'o/ /rang gi dngos ming gsum gyi khyad par/ ngo bo tsam bsgrub pa'i/ nges tshig

ston gyi gzhan la zur mi za ba ste 'di ni me'o zhes pa lta bu dang*/ / me ni me'o zhes pa lta bus me dngos yin gyi me yod pa la sogs pa btags pa ba 'i min zhes/ ming gzhan lnga po/ spong byed dang*/ / tsha ba nyid me'o zhes pa lta bus rang gi khyad par gsal ba sogs pa/ gzhan sel bas/ / te rim pa ltar/ dngos po'i rkyen rnams go rim bzhin/ / btags pa ba bshad pa rten la brten pa 'i ming*/ btags pa gser lta bu/ dang*/ / ni/ brgyud pa'i rgyu la 'bras bu 'i ming btags pa ste chu lud la kha zas zhes pa lta bu dang*/ /dngos kyi rgyu la de bzhin 'bras bu'i ming btags pa dang*/ /'bras bu'am bya ba las su ra gyur pa la/ /de la rgyu gzhan ming btags pa 'ang 'am / /dpe gzhan gyi ni ming dpe can la btags pa ste/ dag dang*// don 'di dag gi sgo nas ni/ /yod dang med la phan pa dang*/ /byed dang las su sgrub pa dang*/ /'dra bar sbyar dang rim bzhin no/ / rgyu/ gal te mig gnyis 'dus pa'am | | 'on te ming*/ mang po 'dus kyang rung*/ / ngo bo/ de dag don gyi/ khyad par rjod byed na/ /tshig ces rab tu brjod pa ste/ / tshig 'brel bar byed pa'i phrad rnams dag dang bcas pa yin/ /de la tshig sdud pa/ gi sbyor ba bcu/ / ste/ 'bru mang pa ོ'i bsdu ba| dang tshig sdud pa'i bsdu ba/ dang*/ khyad par dag dang yan lag dang*/ /gzhi dang gzhi gcig bsdu ba dang*/ /gzhi mthun pa dang de'i skyes bu/ /zlas dbye ba 'i bsdu ba dang phyogs tsam ston pa'i bsdu ba'o// mo/ / ngo bo bstan pa tshig gnyis kyi 'bru mang po dang tshig mang po 'i 'bru mang po gnyis kyi/ rab dbye 1ba sa 'i/ / gang zhe na/2 rang ming ldan dang mi ldan dang*/ /phyogs dang rnam grangs phan tshun dang*/ / de'ang lnga ni 3 tshig gnyis kyi 'bru| mang pa ོ'i dbye ba/ ste 'bru mang po la dbye ba/4 rnam pa drug / de dag re re la'ang bsdu ba'i dbye*/ mthun pa/ dang tha dad ces pa mi mthun pa'i/ dbye ba yis/

/phyogs kun dang mi mthun pa dang*| ni phyogs gcig mthun pa dang mi mthun pa/ las/ /rab tu dbye ba bzhir bshad do | | byed gnyis pa nas bdun pa'i bar gyi/ pa drug gis sgyur ba byed pas bsgyur ba/ ni/ / nyan po| kun la rab tu ldan pa ste/ / de ltar spyir/ brgya dang drug cu rtsa brgyad las/ /dus gcig tu ni gsum ldan gzung*/ / dbye ba bstan pa tshig bsdu ba ni rnam pa lnga/ / tshig gnyis kyi mdor bsdu ba/ dang rnam grangs bye brag dang*/ /gzhan dang byed pa'i tshig yin no/ / lnga po de dag kyang*/ las kyi bsdu ba/ la sogs pa'i dbye ba yis/ /gnyis pa la sogs bdun pa'i mtha'/ /byed pa 'i bsdu ba/ drug tu 'dod pa ste/ /tshig bsdu ba thams cad lnga po 'di/ tsam du shes par bya/ / tshig snga ma khyad par du dang*/ phyi ma khyad par du 'i sbyor ba yis/ khyad par bsdus pa rnam pa gnyis/ /'brel ba 'i yan lag bsdu ba/ dag dang go rim gyi dang*/ /don gyi/ dang grags pa'i yan lag bsdu ba dang ni/ /bsdu ba yin la de bzhi yi bzhi pa/ grags pa'i 'ang*/ /'jig rten la grags pa dang bstan bcos dag las grags pa'i bye brag gis/ gnyis/ / so//bsdu ba bya ba'i rigs bsal bar/ byas pa'i bsdu ba bum pa thams cad ces pa/ dang ma byas pa'i/ / bsdu ba thams cad ces pa/dbye bas gzhi bsdu ba ni gnyis yin no/ /phyogs gcig dag tu byed pa 'i bsdu ba 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag ces pa lta bu/ dang*/ / chos so so ba/ 'i bsdu ba 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas bdag med ces pa lta bu'i/ phyogs gcig byed pa yis/ /gzhi gcig bsdu ba gnyis su'o/ khyad par sngon po dang khyad par can utpal/ gnyis dang*/ / utpa'i sngon po zhes gzhi gcig tu/ sngon po dang rtsub pa'i/ khyad par rnam gnyis utpala'i/ gzhi gcig tu/ / bsdu ba dang*/ mthun par go bar bya ba la/ / 1 sbyor ba 'i bsdu ba ni/ gzhi gcig la/ mthun par go ba'o/ /chos tha dad pa/ rnam pa gnyis/ / bdag ngo bo'am ni chos

ngo bo gcig kyang de'i/ kyang rung*/ /tha dad go bar byed pa yi/ /de yi skyes bu bsdu ba/ gsum yin te/ / gang zhe na/ byed pa'i tshig gi skyes bu/ dang las 'dzin pa'i/ dang*/ /ba gnyis pa 'i/ zhes bya ba 'o/ / gsum pa ོde 'i dang po/ la 'ang*/ byed pa 'i tshig gi dbye bas/ brgyad yin te/ / byed tshig gi dbye ba spyir bstan/ dang po nas ni bdun pa'i mtha'/ / 'i bar chod pa ma gtogs pa/ rnam par/ dbye ba'i/ bsgyur ba bdun po 1dang*//phrad 3 bod pa bzhag pa ni/ dang sbyor ba bral ba'i phyir/ /gzhan dang sbyor byed med/ bod pa spangs/ /2dgag pa dang ni brgyad du 'dod/ / dgag pa la du zhe na mtshan nyid tha dad pa'i/ dbang gis phye ba yis/ / dgag pa'i bsdu ba khyad par du bshad pa la gnyis las bstan par/ ma yin dgag pa bcu bzhi dang*/ /mtshan nyid tha dad kyi dbang gis dbye ba med mod kyi/ /yul dang dus kyis tha dad pa'i phye ba yi//med par dgag pa bcu gcig po de/ dag / dang*/ gang ldan pa ni/ dgag pa'i bsdu bar/ 'dod pa yin no/ / 'o/ / bshad pa la gnyis las/ ma yin pa dgag pa bcu bzhi gang zhe na gzhan pa la ma yin| dang rig pa'i/ mi mthun pa la ma rig pa/ chags pa'i gnyen po la ma chags pa/ dang*/ / gzugs chung la med pa dang 'du shes/ phra ba la med pa dang rdzas nyung ba la med pa/ dang*/ / dus yun thung ba la med pa dang grangs lhag ma med pa la grangs med pa/ dang*/ / rgyu ni 'bras bu/ mtha' dag skyed pa/ min mi skyed pa dang gtan nas/ bral ba la myang 'das dang*/ / bu dman pa la med pa/ dang 'gros/ zhan la mi 'gro ba/ dang spobs pa/ zhum pa la med ces dang*/ / rnam par rig byed dang 'dra ba ma yin pa dag la rnam par rig byed ma yin pa zhes dgag pa ni/ /ma yin dgag tu/ par 'dod pa'o/ / med dgag bcu gcig gang zhe na rgyun 'dra ba snga na med pa/ zhig nas med pa dang rang bzhin snga na med pa dang*/ / gnas skabs snga na med pa dang rten la snga nas gyi med pa dang dbye ba yis/

/ gang la sngar dang zhig nas med pa gnyis la/ / 2 dbye ba rnam pa brgyad yin te/ /shin la las zla'i/yod/ tu med pa'i dbye ba yis/ / bum pa la ka ba lta bu phan tshun ci shos/ dag la ci shos kyi rang bzhin med pa dang*/ /rgyu shin tu med pa nam mkha'i rgyu lta bu/ dang rang bzhin shin tu med pa ri bong gi rwa lta bu/ gnyis su/ dbye ba sa 'i/ /shin tu med pa la/ dang bcu gcig ni/ /med par dgag par 'dod pa'o/ / lhan cig 'brel ba'i tshig gi don kun tu log cing 'gog pa'i/ phyir dgag pa yin | | no// de nyid las/ gzhan du mi brjod pa'i tshig gi sbyor ba utpala'i sngon po lta bu dang*// 'dra ba gzhan gyis ni skyes bu seng ge lta bu dang bye brag gi /tshig sbyor bar byed pa tsha rtsub lta bu dang gsum ni las 'dzin no//grangs kyi tshig dang bsdu ba'i tshig gi don sbyor ba yis//gcig gi tshig gis gcig tu ston pa/ dang mang po'i tshig gis/ tha dad par/ sbyor byed pa/ / ni/ ba gnyis pa zhes 'dod pa'o/ / sa chu me rlung ni 'byung ba zhes pa lta bu bsdu ba'i phyir dang chos ni 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa zhes lta bu/ dbye phyir dang*/ /nye ba'i phyir dang sbyor byed dang*/ / de gnyis ka yang nye bar tha dad pa go bar byed pas/ sbyor ba'i phyir/ / zer/bsdu ba la'ang 'das pa 'i sgra sdud pa dang*/ dag dang tha dad pa/ gzhan ma smos pa'i don/ dag sdud pa/ dang | | lan grangs gzhan la smos pa'i tshig sdud par/ sbyor byed pa/ / ni/ zlas 'byed pas sam zla dang 'byed pas/ dbye ba zhes 'dod pa yin/ / sems tsam zhes pa lta bu sems/ rang gi rigs tsam sdud par/ byed cing*/ / sems ma yin pa'i phyogs gzhan kun tu spong ba dang | | sems rang gi tshad 'di tsam zhes/ rigs kyi tshad kyang mi 'dzin pa/ / ni/ phyogs tsam ston pa'i sbyor ba'o/ / tshig gang zhig la/ rang la bstan bya'i/ gi don med 1 cing*/ / 2 don gzhan/ gyi brjod bya'i/ 2 ming la 4 gsal

ba la phan 'dogs par/ byed pa/ / ni tshig gi phrad ces bya ba ste/ /de dang*/ ldan pa ni/ phrad dang bcas pa yin/ /de la phrad kyi 'jug pa ni/ /gang zhes pa/ ni 'dri ba'i tshig gi don/ /spyi la khyab par sbyor byed do | | ste tshig slar sdud pa la kun tu spang*/ /ci dang ji dang su/ la sogs pa de bzhin te | | ji snyed dang gang su dag la sogs pa 'jug pa'i khyab pa skabs kyis brtsi bar bya/ /de zhes bya ba'i tshog gi don/ /tha snyad

la 'jug pa dang*/ dngos dngos po la 'jug pa dus la/ 'jug pa gsum/ / dang po la'ang 'das pa la/ dang rnam grangs gzhan yod par sbyor ba/ can dang*/ /lhag ma dag dang bcas par ston/ pa'o// gnyis pa la'ang*/ bden pa la 'jug pa/ dag dang gsang ba la/ dang*/ /bdag gi ba la/ dang pha rol la 'jug pa ste/ po'i | | dngos po dag la 'jug pa bzhi/ / gsum pa la'ang*/ 'das pa la/ dang ni ma 'ongs pa'i/ /dus nyid la ni 'jug pa gnyis/ / dngos po'i skabs su bdag nyid dang dus kyi skabs su/ da lta nyid la 'jug pa/ spang*/ /dngos po la 'jug pa/ 'i dus la 'jug pa| ni mi 'dor te/ / gang zhe na/dus gsum po kun gyi spyi la 'jug pa/ la rab tu sbyar bar bya// 'di zhes pa'i/ tshig ni/ 'das pa la/ dang ma 'ongs pa la/ dang*/ /skabs kyis dngos po| gzhan dag la 'jug / 1pa'o//3nye ba dang mngon sum du gang gis 'jog na gang zhig la ni ltos byas pa'i/ / dngos po la 'jug pa la'ang 2 nye ba dag la dang mngon sum pa la 'jug pa 'i/ /dngos po dag kyang gnyis yin 4 no/ / 'di'i tshul du/ spang bar bya ba 'di lta ste/ / don/ lkog tu gyur pa/ dang dngos po rgyang*/ ring ba dang*/ /gal te 'di zhes bya ba'i sgra/ bstan par/ bya 'i zer/ dus nyid la sbyor ba/ na/ /'das dang ma 'ongs pa la 'jug pa/ spang parabya/ / gang dang*/ de dang*/ 'di zhes pa de rnams kun la bsgyur ba bdun dang*| ldan/ / no/ da zhes bya ba'i sgra ni don bshad pa'i skabs su bab pa'i tshig / ste de yang*/ da ltar byung ba'i dus su bshad pa/ la sbyor ba ste/ /'das pa'i dus/ skabs la 'jug pa/ rnam par spang*/ /na zhes bya ba'i tshig gi don/ / ni/ dmigs kyi phye nas gal 'dzugs pa dang gzhung 'dzugs pa gnyis/ 'byed dbye/ dang rgyu dang*/ mtshan ma'i tshig gnyis dang*/ / yod pa'i tshig gis 'gegs pa' ིrgyu mtshan don gyis bstan pa dang*/ /las dang ched la la zla ba'i| la med/ dang rten gnas dang*/ /phyi ma'i/ tshig snga ma/ de las/ gzhan pa dang 'gal ba la/ sogs ston

pa/ dang*/ / ma ི'os pa 'i tshig gi/ ra dka' ba chag 'dzin las/ /phyi ma'i| tshig nges par byed pa lha yang phyag 'tshal na mi lta ci smos zhes pa lta bu dang*/ /de las bzlog pa snga ma'i tshig gis phyi ma ma nges par byed pa/ nyid dang ni/ /'gal ba'ang mi 'gal ston pa don dam par ni dbyer med na kun rdzob tu yod ces pa lta bu/ dang*/ / bdag byang chub thob par bya na zhes pa lta bu/ smon pa'i gzhi/ dang 'dri ba'i/ dang the tshim gzhi/ / 'di skad dus gcig na zhes pa lta bu/ tshe skabs rnams la 'di mthong ngo*/ /ste ni don bshad pa'i/ lhag ma yod pa ste/ /mtshams sbyor ba dang dam bca' ba/ dang*/ /gzhan 'dren pa dang gsum du 'dod/ / tshig snga ma byed par/ dang phyi ma/ bya ba sbyor ba la dus mi mthun pa/ 'am 2 yang na ni/ / 1snga phyi gnyis ka bya ba nyid du sbyor ba gang*/ / 3 tshig gnyis rim par dang*| mam 4 dus gcig tu/ /sbyor bar byed pa mtshams sbyor yin/ / tshig phyi ma/ gang zhig gis ni tshig snga ma/ snga ma la/ /gsal bar phan 'dogs/ bar byed pa dam bca' ba/ / bstan bya'i don/ lhag ma yod pa tsam ston par/ 'gyur zhing*/ / des/ de las gzhan du/ gyur ba'i tshig gzhan 'dren pa'o/ /dang ni chos ni 'khor ba dang 'das pa zhes pa lta bu 'byed dang 'khor ba dang 'das pa'i chos zhes pa lta bu/ sdud pa dang*/ / zhi gnas brtan pa dang lhag mthong 'phel ba lta bu rgyu mtshan dang*/ tshe skabs la dang*/ gdams ngag la 'jug pa lnga/ / sdud pa 'ba' zhig la'ang*/ de dag nye ba nyid bstan pa bsdu ba/ dang ni dngos po/ gzhan dag bsdu ba/ dang*/ /lan grangs gzhan la sbyor ba'i tshe/ /sdud pa'i dang yang gsum du 'dod/ /ni ni phyogs skyong bcu las byang gnod sbyin ni lha'i dbang po lta bu | dgar dang sems ni sems byung dang ldan pa lta bu brnan pa'i tshig / me ni tshig ces pa lta bu/ dmigs sam ni/ nges par 'dzin pa ste/ /phyi ma'i tshig dang sbyar ba bya/ /kyang dang yang ni rigs 'dra ba/ sdud pa'i tshig

/ de lta yin kyang zhes pa lta bu mi mthun mthun par ston pa'ang yin/ / bsdus pa'i yul ni 'das pa'am ma 'ongs gzhan dag la/ / ma smos pa gzhan ci rigs dag tu bsdu bar bya/ /yang zhes bya ba skabs kha cig tu bsnan pa'ang yin | | nges par gzung ba kho na/ 'i tshig gi don/ / sangs rgyas ni yon tan rdzogs pa kho na dang ldan zhes pa gzhan mi ldan par nges par gzung ba dang buddha kho na yon tan rdzogs pa dang ldan zhes pa/ gzhan la min/ / pa dang*/ ldan pa tsam du 'dzin pa'i padma la mtsho skyes yod pa kho na lta bu dang*/ / gzhan mi ldan pa dang*/ gzhan la mi ldan par ma nges pa ni rnam pa gnyis/ / chos rnams kyi de kho na lta bu bden zhing mi bslu ba nyid dang*/ kho na dag ni rnam pa drug /nyid ni phal cher/ de bzhin yin la cung zad mi 'dra ba ni utpal nyid sngon po zhes pa lta bu/ du// phyi ma'i/ tshig rang las tha dad min pa sbyor pa dang*/ / sra ba nyid sa zhes pa lta bu rang gi dngos po ston pa 'i rkyen du 'gyur ba'o/ / rdul phran tsam zhes pa lta bu tshad 'dzin pa dang ni sems tsam lta bu/ lhag ma 'gog pa yi/ /tsam zhes bya ba rnam pa gnyis/ /'ba' zhig la sha stag la/ sogs de bzhin du/ sbyar/ / te/ khyab pa gang che ba/ skabs kyi shugs/ kyis brtsi bar bya/ /yang dag par zhe'am/ yongs su zhe'am/ kun tu rab tu shin tu la/ sogs/ / sgra ji/ bzhin pa/ dang ni tshig gzhan gyi/ phrad du'o/ /tshul ni chos/ 'dra ba/ dang smad pa mi ngan pa la mi'i tshul/ dang*/ / don gyi sgo la 'don gyi tshul/ dang sdom pa la tshul la zhugs pa dang*/ mtshan nyid la ngang tshul bzang ngan/ dang*/ /thabs la byed tshul/ dang rigs rig pa don dang 'dod zer/ dang ldan pa la tshul dang ldan pa dang*/ don bzang ba la tshul bzang po dang dang 'dod/ / la 'jug pa ni bzhin gyi tshul lugs dang*/ legs pa ra byed pa/ dag la 'jug pa tshul gzhan du byed ces pa las/ / ( rtsor/gtso bor ) 'dra bar sbyar zer/ 'dra bar sbyar ba phrad du

la la la zla'i med| 'dod/ /bzhin la sogs pa de bzhin dang de lta bu la sogs pa 'i tshig gi don/ / de bzhin nyid lta bu ma nor ba dang de lta bu'o zhes pa lta bu yin pa dang*/ / de bzhin no zhes pa lta bu/ 'dra ba dag tu sbyor ba'o/ /cing zhing shing*/ la sogs pa yang de ltar snga ma/ bsdu ba dang*/ / de ltar phyi ma dang mtshams sbyar dag tu byed pa yin/ /la ni shing la gcod pa lta bu/ gnyis pa shing la chu 'dren pa lta bu/ bzhi pa dang*/ / shing la bya gnas pa lta bu bdun pa lag pa bkrus la zan bza' ba lta bu sdud dang 'di na yod pa 'di na med ces pa lta bu/ sbyor ba dang*/ / 'di lta bur gyur la zhes pa lta bu smon dang de tsam la lta bu/ tshad 'dzin gzhi nyid/ dang ni/ /tshe skabs de la lta bu/ skabs dag tu 'dod pa yin/ /gyi kyi ni lha byin gyi rta lta bu/ 'brel ba'i don yin te/ / lha byin gyis shing bcad lta bu/ ni byed par 'dod pa yin/ /mi mthun rgyan ni la dang*/ kyi dang*/ kyis/ gsum char kun la'o/ /las ni sa bon las myu gu lta bu/ rgyu dang ri las gser lta bu/ 'byung khungs dang*/ / khyim pa las dge bsnyen lta bu dgar ba yin te nas la'ang gsum po/ de bzhin/ / la/mig nas lus kyi bar zhes pa lta bu/ sdud pa dag dang kha gdangs nas nyal zhes pa lta bu/ mtshams sbyor ni/ /nas la las zhes pa'i sgra las/ cung zad lhag pa yin/ / gnas brgyad las/ gtan tshigs ston pa'i sgra/ dag tu 'gyur ba na/ / ni/ drug pa 'ba' zhig ma gtogs pa gnyis pa nas bdun pa'i bar lnga'o// so/ /du dang su dang ru/ la sogs pa la 'i sgra/ dang mthun/ /de nyid dag la 'phang du rtsigs dang mig mangs ris su btang la sogs/ ni nyid zer/ lhag pa yin/ /shin de bzhin/ tu lag pa bkrus la zan za lta bu/ lhag pa dang*/ bcas par/ la la sbyar ba/ 'o/ /'o la sogs pa la la la med zla'i/ slar sdud pa'o | | 'on te dang 'o na zhes pa tshig snga ma'i don/ ni khong du chud pa la/ 'i tshig

/phyi ma skabs zla'i la yod/ dang sbyar ba'o/ /'am dang sam dang ngam dang gam dang dam dang nam bam mam ram lam/ zhes bya ba bcu ni/ 'byed pa dang*/ sdud pa/ yin/ /dag dang rnams ni mang po'i tshig | sogs ni dang po'i tshig gis tshig mtha' dag smos mi dgos par sdud pa yin/ / pa'am can ni de la dbang ba'i bdag po'am/ / de dang ldan pa'i don du sbyar bar bya/ / bya ba ston pa'i ming la ba 'isgra byung ba/ ni spyi ru bzhag pa ste/ / 'di dang 'di'i tshe bza' zhes pa lta bu yul dus nges par ma bzung pa'o/ / dper na za ba zhes pa'i sgra de/ bza' bya/ dang za po spyir 'jug pa/ bzhin/ / te phyogs gcig du ma chad pas/ ma ning dag lta bu spyir/ tu bzhag ma ni dge 'dun zer zla'i/ par bya/ / 'o// gal te tshig phrad gnyis 'dus pa'am/ / 'on te yang na phrad/ mang po 'dus pa na/ / gsum du gyur te/ tshig snga mas/ phyi ma/ phyi mas snga ma/ phan tshun gnyis/ zil gyis/ gnon pa dang*/ /rang gi cha ldan pa/ dag tu sbyar/ / te/ 'di ltar gal te na zhes pa lta bu'i/ zla'i med gang la 'i sgra ni/ dmigs 'dzin par/ mi byed par/ dang | | khyab pa spyir sbyor la de nyid dmigs 'dzin par byed pa te na 'i sgra dang*/ phrad gal te na zhes par/ 'gyur na/ / don snga mas phyi ma gzhan yod par ston gnyis ka'i cha dang ldan/ par 'gyur gyur/ pa'i sgra'i/ mthun bzhin de gzhan la'ang sbyor/ no/ / don gyi/ phyogs gcig khong du chud pa las/ / ma chud pa'i phyogs gzhan gcig 'dri bar byed pa ni/ /'o na zhes pa'i nus pa'o/ /de la 'on te na zhes pa'i sgra la/ 'o na zhes pa/ dmigs 'dzin ci byed pa| snga ma bzhin/ / la/ gzhan 'dren byed pa ni/ te 'i sgra/ yin te/ /na 'i sgra/ yis ni/ phyogs gcig dmigs 'dzin pa/ dag tu byed do/ / spyi dang phyogs gcig la 'jug la de gnyis dang*/ ldan pa'i phrad du 'dus pa'i tshig rnams ni/ /dmigs kyis 'dzin pa dang ldan mi ldan gnyis pa ste/ / don gyis dmigs 'dzin yod na
